control.description-key: FY27 Realignment entry builder. State path: pick the debiting Prioritization, multi-select its Prioritization Funding junctions with per-line move amounts, pick the crediting Prioritization and credit Requirement Funding, and balance Itemized Detail reductions and increases. OPR path: move TDP from one Requirement Funding to another, reducing the debit side Requirement Detail funding by whatever Withholding cannot cover and optionally funding the credit side Requirement Details. The entry type defaults from the user roles with a toggle for dual-role and Checkbook Administrator users. Bind to book_newamount on the Realignment form.

property.name: amount
property.description-key: The bound field (book_newamount, Decimal). The control reads and writes the rest of the record via Web API.
